name: info
description: Engine version and commit, project name, build type (editor / template_debug), PID, .NET runtime version, active Harmony patches, and activation time.

name: tree
description: Export the live SceneTree hierarchy (paths, classes, scripts, and optional property summaries).

name: get
description: Read any property on a Node via Godot Variant API (works for both GDScript and C# nodes).

property.description: Property name or indexed path (e.g. position, position:x).

name: set
description: Write any property on a Node via Godot Variant API.

value.description: New value (number, bool, string, Vector/Color dict or string expression like 'Vector3(1,2,3)' or 'Color(1,0,0,1)').

name: call
description: Invoke any method on a Node via Godot Variant API.

name: eval_gd
description: Evaluate a GDScript Expression with optional `self` node context.

name: run_gd
description: Compile and execute a temporary GDScript (`func run(ctx):`) at runtime and return the result.

code.description: GDScript body of `func run(ctx):` or full script.

name: eval_cs
description: Execute arbitrary C# code using Roslyn Scripting. Globals: Tree, Root, CurrentScene, Node(path), Find<T>(), FindAll<T>(), Log(msg), Traverse(obj), GetPrivate(obj, name), SetPrivate(obj, name, val), CallPrivate(obj, name, args...). State persists across calls within the session. Only one evaluation may run at a time. Cancellation is cooperative: timeout/reset can return while code is still running. Main-thread code must return promptly. Use Cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested() in long loops. Worker code must not access the SceneTree.

thread.description: Execution thread: 'main' (between frames) or 'worker' (for read-only heavy analysis).

timeout_ms.description: Cooperative cancellation and response deadline, not a hard execution limit.

name: patch_cs
description: Compile a C# patch with Roslyn and apply it at runtime via Harmony. Returns patch ID and inline warning if applicable.

code.description: C# patch body (has access to __instance, __result, method parameters, or full static method).

name: unpatch
description: Revert a single Harmony patch by ID or all patches ('all').

name: list_patches
description: List all active C# Harmony patches (id, target, kind, applied_at, call_count).

name: pause
description: Pause or resume the SceneTree.

paused.description: True to pause, false to resume (omit to toggle).

name: step
description: Advance N process frames and pause. Physics ticks depend on engine timing.

name: time_scale
description: Get or set Engine.time_scale.

name: screenshot
description: Capture the main viewport as PNG (save to file path and/or return base64 PNG).

path.description: Optional file path to save PNG.

name: logs
description: Return the most recent N log entries from the in-memory ring buffer (including errors and warnings).

name: dump
description: Write a Windows process minidump (mini or full) via MiniDumpWriteDump to user://ai_debug/dumps/.

name: hook_native
description: Hook a native C/C++ function by symbol name (resolved via DbgHelp + PDB) or export using MinHook (Windows x64). Modes: 'log' (records first 4 integer arg registers rcx/rdx/r8/r9, return value rax, and call count), 'return_const' (immediately returns a 64-bit integer constant), or 'dll' (redirects to an exported function in an Agent-compiled DLL).

symbol.description: C++ symbol name (e.g. 'SceneTree::is_paused'), 'module.dll!export', or hex address '0x...'.

dll_path.description: Path to replacement DLL when mode='dll'.

export.description: Exported function name in replacement DLL.

name: unhook_native
description: Remove a native hook by ID (e.g. 'nh1'), symbol name, or 'all'.

name: list_native_hooks
description: List active native C++ hooks, call counts, and recent logged register/return values.

name: reset
description: Cancel pending C# evaluations cooperatively, clear the script session, remove debugger patches/hooks, and restore initial pause/time_scale. Does not undo property writes or arbitrary script side effects. Reports cleanup failures and executions that may still be running.
